name: display_ref_name_other_key_with_matching_name_ignored
description: An update filed under a DIFFERENT refNameHash does not name this ref, even though its refName hashes to the key being queried — the key guard, not the preimage check, is what rejects it. Pins the preimage/key FILTER, not the newest-wins ordering: two distinct names cannot hash to one key, so which matching update wins is unobservable through this rule.
